name: AimAcre
tagline: The quiet workbench for coaches who take their players' improvement personally.
positioning: AimAcre gives independent esports coaches one calm place to run VOD reviews, track rank progress, and schedule scrims — so the craft of coaching stops getting buried under spreadsheets and Discord threads.

hero.h1: Coaching that actually stays with your players
hero.sub: You didn't start coaching to babysit spreadsheets and lost VOD links. AimAcre keeps every review, rank note, and scrim block in one place, so your players feel the progress — and remember who got them there.

features.title: VOD reviews that leave a mark
features.description: Drop a timestamped note straight onto the replay, tag the mistake, and send players a clean recap they'll actually reopen before the next match. No more 'go back to minute twelve.'

features.title: Rank progress you can point to
features.description: Track each player's ladder climb, win conditions, and the habits you're drilling. When a parent or a player asks 'is this working?', you have the answer on one page.

features.title: Scrims without the group-chat chaos
features.description: Post availability, lock scrim blocks, and confirm five-stacks without forty Discord pings. Everyone sees the same schedule, in their own timezone.

features.title: Session notes that carry forward
features.description: Every drill, correction, and homework assignment lives on the player's timeline, so week nine picks up exactly where week eight ended.

features.title: Billing built for one-person shops
features.description: Per-seat plans, automatic renewals, and tidy receipts. You coach; AimAcre handles the awkward 'did you pay for this month' conversation.

features.title: Your studio, your name
features.description: Custom booking page, your logo on the recaps, your colors on the ladder. Players remember your academy, not the software behind it.

testimonials.quote: I used to lose an hour every night re-finding replay clips across three chats. Now the recap writes itself while I review, and my players show up to the next session having actually watched it.
testimonials.name: Marcus Delaney

testimonials.quote: The rank timeline sold me. When a player's parent wanted proof the lessons were paying off, I turned the laptop around and let the ladder do the talking.
testimonials.name: Priya Venkatesan

testimonials.quote: Running scrims for four squads used to eat my weekends. AimAcre put every block on one calendar and my no-show rate dropped in a month.
testimonials.name: Diego Farrow

pricing.blurb: For the coach running the whole operation out of one notebook and sheer will.
For the small academy with a real roster and a name to protect.
For multi-coach programs coordinating dozens of players.

homepage.footerBlurb: AimAcre is the workbench for independent esports coaches — VOD reviews, rank tracking, scrims, and billing in one calm place, so the craft of coaching outlasts the group chat.
